parameters.responseBody: ={{ $json.http_status === 200 ? { status: $json.outcome, event_id: $json.event_id } : ($json.http_status === 401 ? { error: "unauthorized" } : ($json.http_status === 400 ? { error: "invalid payload", details: $json.reason } : { error: "server error" })) }}

nodeGroups.name: Authenticate
nodeGroups.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body + 5-minute timestamp window. Failures get 401 and a log entry.

nodeGroups.name: Validate
nodeGroups.description: Required fields and types. Failures get 400 and a log entry with every reason.

nodeGroups.name: Deduplicate
nodeGroups.description: Same shop + event_id is processed once. Repeats get 200 and are only logged.

nodeGroups.name: Store
nodeGroups.description: Saves the event before answering, so 200 always means stored.

nodeGroups.name: Reply and log
nodeGroups.description: Answers the sender first, then writes the request log.
